MARCUS
We need to talk about what happened last night.

ELENA
There is nothing to talk about. It was a mistake.

MARCUS
Mistakes usually do not involve planning a heist, Elena.

ELENA
I did not plan anything. I improvised.

MARCUS
You improvised stealing a ledger from a high security vault.

ELENA
And I got it, didn't I? 

MARCUS
That is not the point. The point is that you bypassed my security protocols in under three minutes.

ELENA
Your security protocols are outdated. I was just proving a point.

MARCUS
And what point was that? That you can ruin years of my work on a whim?

ELENA
To show you that you are vulnerable. If I can do it, anyone can.

MARCUS
Nobody else has your clearance or your reckless disregard for consequences.

ELENA
You wanted results. I gave you results. 

MARCUS
I wanted a partner, Elena, not a loose cannon who goes rogue whenever she feels bored.

ELENA
Boredom has nothing to do with it. We needed that ledger to expose them.

MARCUS
There was a legal way to acquire it.

MARCUS (CONT'D)
Legal would have taken months. They would have scrubbed the servers by then.

ELENA (CONT'D)
You do not know that for sure.

ELENA (CONT'D)
I know how these people operate better than you do. You are too used to playing by the rules.

MARCUS
Rules are the only thing separating us from the criminals we are chasing.

ELENA
Sometimes you have to cross the line to get the job done.

MARCUS
And who decides where that line is? You?

ELENA
Someone has to make the hard choices, Marcus. If you are not willing to do it, I will.

MARCUS
That arrogance is going to get us both killed.

ELENA
Or it is going to keep us alive. Either way, we have the ledger now. What is your next move?

MARCUS
My next move is trying to figure out how to clean up your mess before they realize it is missing.

ELENA
They already know. That is why we do not have time to argue about rules.
